name: Garland
source:
A Shinigami dressed in pitch black. Due to his excessive interference with humans and their emotions, he's known as the 'Strange Shinigami' by those around him.

[Translated from [url=https://enoshima210.work/2024/05/28/karuta/]official site[/url]]
